rationale: Both independently caught the same strong AR-diffusion runner bug, but X better echoes the ground truth's dominant theme (validation redundancy/consolidation across layers, and missing DTO-local invariants paralleling the sibling PR's stricter contract) plus ships concrete patch-level fixes.
